attr.title: KeeperFX
attr.desc:
KeeperFX is an open-source remake and fan expansion of Dungeon Keeper.

The main goal of KeeperFX is to preserve and expand upon the original Dungeon Keeper experience, offering many new features, improvements, and much more while staying true to the original feeling of the game.

You can delve into the original campaign, or enjoy custom content created by the community and shared on the Workshop.
attr.inst: KeeperFX 1.4.0 needs files from the original Dungeon Keeper (CD, GOG, EA or Steam release). Copy bluepal.dat, bluepall.dat, dogpal.pal, hitpall.dat, lightng.pal, main.pal, mapfadeg.dat, redpal.col, redpall.dat, slab0-0.dat, slab0-1.dat, vampal.pal and whitepal.col into ports/keeperfx/data, and atmos1.sbk, atmos2.sbk and bullfrog.sbk into ports/keeperfx/sound. Upper or lower case file names both work. GOG: they are in the DATA and SOUND folders of the installed game; its keeper02.ogg to keeper07.ogg music files can go into ports/keeperfx/music.
